sentences.text: You can work remotely ___ your performance remains consistent.
They won’t change their packaging ___ regulations force them to do so.
We should not trust sustainability claims ___ they are backed by real data.
The company promotes its ‘eco-friendly’ products, but they are not truly sustainable ___ they reduce their carbon footprint.
She will believe their sustainability reports ___ they include third-party verification.
Emarsys employees can choose flexible hours ___ they meet their deadlines.
We won’t see real environmental change ___ companies stop greenwashing their products.
He won’t invest in the company ___ they adopt a real sustainability strategy.
Emarsys will continue offering hybrid work options ___ employees remain productive.
The marketing team will keep using ‘eco-friendly’ labels ___ customers demand transparency.
They will keep producing single-use plastics ___ new laws ban them.
You shouldn’t trust a company’s ‘green’ initiatives ___ they provide real evidence.
The office will stay open ___ the last employee leaves.
I will continue supporting this brand ___ they maintain ethical practices.
We can keep the lights on in the office ___ we switch to renewable energy.
The team will work on the project ___ it brings value to customers.
The company can claim sustainability ___ they prove their products are truly eco-friendly.
Our green initiatives won’t be effective ___ employees actively participate.
The sustainability report won’t be published ___ all data is verified.
The referee won’t stop the match ___ a serious injury occurs.
The players will keep training ___ they master the new defensive strategy.
You can stay on the field ___ you follow the rules and play fair.
The coach won’t let you play in the next match ___ you improve your tackling technique.
The team won’t celebrate ___ they secure the championship title.
The boxer can continue fighting ___ the doctor allows it.
The player won’t be substituted ___ they show signs of exhaustion.
The tournament will go on ___ the weather conditions remain safe for play.
The fans will wait in the stadium ___ the team comes out to celebrate.
The referee will not allow the game to resume ___ all players are in their positions.
